vm_capture_semantics.rule: M() creates each child upvalue proxy with a backing pair {parent_T_table, register_index}; proxy __index reads parent_T[register_index] and __newindex writes parent_T[register_index].
vm_capture_semantics.consequence: OP_387 captures a live shared register cell, not a snapshot value. Later writes to the parent register are visible through every closure capturing that cell.

limitations: This manifest records creation PCs, destination registers and raw capture cells only. It does not by itself prove the business meaning of every parent register.
Root module field/global assignments and shared-cell initial values still require PC-level dataflow reconciliation.
